BETA Close X Drax Group PLC has announced the purchase of 72,200 ordinary shares on March 20, 2026, as part of its share buyback program. The volume-weighted average price paid per share was 887.0993 pence, with the lowest price at 872.5000 pence and the highest at 899.0000 pence. Following this transaction, Drax Group has 432,461,089 ordinary shares in issue, with 95,558,479 held in treasury, resulting in 336,902,610 voting rights. Since the program's inception on July 31, 2025, a total of 8,417,079 ordinary shares have been repurchased. Disclaimer* Drax Group PLC 23 March 2026 23 March 2026 Drax Group plc Transactions in own shares Drax Group plc (Drax Group) announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the "Programme") announced on 31 July 2025, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 11 16/29 pence each (Ordinary Shares) on the London Stock Exchange through J.P. Morgan Securities plc. Date of purchase: 20 March 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 72,200 Lowest price paid per ordinary share (p): 872.5000 Highest price paid per ordinary share (p): 899.0000 Volume weighted average price paid per share (p): 887.0993 Following the above transaction, Drax Group will have 432,461,089 Ordinary Shares in issue, including treasury shares. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 95,558,479. The total number of voting rights in Drax Group, excluding treasury shares as at 20 March 2026 is 336,902,610. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Drax Group under the FCA's Disclosure and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 31 July 2025, Drax Group has purchased 8,417,079 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for treasury.
